name: poxian · 网关提示词中间件

summary.en: Magpie gateway middleware: writes your system prompt into every request at that protocol's own system slot — idempotent marks, payload cleaning, echo/refusal probes, per-route prefill. Install: search `poxian` in magpie.
summary.zh: magpie 网关中间件：把系统提示词写进每个经过网关的请求，落在各协议自己的 system 位。幂等标记、报文清洗、回显/拒答探针、按路由预填。安装：magpie 里搜 `poxian`。
